steps.text: Install the fuel injection pipes @ and tighten the sleeve nuts (1) to the specified torque. The sleeve nut tightening torque for in-line type injection pump and the distributor type pump is identical. Tighten them a little at a time evenly so that no undue stress is applied on the pipe line. Injection Pipe Sleeve Nut Torque kg-m (Ib.ft/N-m) 2.5 — 3.5 (23.1 — 30.3/24.5 — 34.3)
